coverImageAlt: Interlocking stone, wood, navy, cyan, and orange modules form a bridge across a slate ravine.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A reusable architecture building block represented by a set of distinct precision-cut modules locking together to form a load-bearing bridge across a narrow gap.
Scene/backdrop: A minimal slate ravine set into layered warm paper terrain.
Subject: Several chunky stone, wood, navy, and translucent cyan modules joining around one sparing orange keystone connector.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe modular bridge silhouette; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: robust, modular, quietly confident
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no engraved symbols or markings; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
